title: MEIKO — Wink, I Was Never Here!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: MEIKO, there you are.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Honami, welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Congratulations on your reading event.
I'm glad it ended up going so well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm also glad that the children enjoyed the story so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Although, when I heard your voice, I became a bit startled...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I couldn't help it.
I mean, it was such a wonderful event.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Anyway, you were looking for me?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
I brought over the books you asked for the other day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you! I've been waiting for these.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “The Star-Chasing Dog” was so good that I wanted to see what other picture books you recommend.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're saying that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, this book...
The lion on the cover is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, that's “My Friend Is A Lion”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's about a lion who is very kind but is feared by those around him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He's a considerate creature who thinks about everyone else more than himself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I love this story because it fills my heart with so much warmth after I read it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds really nice!
Wait, what about this book?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's “The Bell Of Bravery Rings In Your Heart”. It's about a boy who is afraid of many things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He always ran from the things he feared, but he finds the courage to protect something he cares deeply about...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember being so excited by this story when I was little.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. This also sounds like a good one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still... Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Just a thought.
These books remind me of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. The way this lion thinks about the well-being of those around him reminded me of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And this boy working up the courage to protect something he cares about is no different.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. You're an incredibly kind person, Honami, so it makes sense that your favorite picture books would be filled with so much warmth.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're a nice reflection of who you are as a person.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm feeling a little embarrassed hearing you say that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Hona! When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What were you two talking about just now? It sounded like a fun conversation...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Honami brought over some picture books for me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Picture books?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha! That's all MEIKO's been talking about lately. She keeps going on and on about how amazing the story you read was, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? Now I'm starting to get curious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I brought quite a few, so I hope you'll read any that catch your eye.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I was thinking...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to read any books that catch their interest to them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After seeing you read that story, I feel like doing the same thing now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, you can do what she did?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I hope you're both ready.
Alright, you two, let's pick a book.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're more than welcome to stay and listen, Honami. I'd also appreciate any tips regarding storytelling.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...!
I can't wait to see how you present these stories, MEIKO!
